title: Mixer
description: Sums several tracks into one, each with its own gain and pan. Drag the grip at the bottom right to add input lanes (4 to 16); lanes that are in use cannot be taken away.

parameters.name: gains
parameters.doc: The level of each input in decibels.

parameters.name: pan
parameters.doc: The place of each input: l (left), c (centre), r (right) or a number from -32 to 32, one value per input (pan l r). Any place other than centre makes the mix stereo, even when every input is mono.

parameters.name: inputs
parameters.doc: How many input lanes the block shows (4 to 16). Dragging the grip of the block changes it.

parameters.name: channels
parameters.doc: auto: stereo when an input or the source is stereo, otherwise mono; mono: sum to mono; stereo: always two channels (a mono sound is copied to both). With stereo the mix is stereo even when every input is mono (both sides equal unless pan places the inputs); auto is stereo only when an input is.
